doc: Every spoken line of the cut-scenes, written by assets/src/build_cutscenes.py. Make a clip with assets.generate_voice {text, path: 'assets/voice/<id>.mp3', voice: voices[speaker]}, then add it to data/cutscenes/voice.json with its length in seconds.

voices.doc: The provider voice of each speaker, for assets.generate_voice (OpenAI voice names; pass them as `voice`). The narrator has one too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Larkspur Lodge. Eleven at night, and the storm has taken the road, the telephone and most of the good humour.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Close the door, porter, you are letting the whole mountain in.

lines.speaker: haas
lines.text: The pass is shut till morning. Nobody comes, nobody goes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You have the keys, the stove and a house full of strangers until dawn.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The supper went cold on the long table. Dr. Vale's chair was still pushed back, as if he meant to return.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A locked door on the upstairs landing, and a house that has stopped pretending to sleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wind found one note it liked and kept it. Below the kitchen, the old way waited behind the wine.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wind drops all at once, like a breath let go. The windows go from black to grey.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Is it quiet, or have I gone deaf in that hole?

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: It is quiet, Ansel. Sit. You have a great deal to tell us.

lines.speaker: haas
lines.text: The third shelf turns on a hinge nobody has oiled in thirty years. Put your shoulder to it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The rack swings inward with a sound like a long breath, and the lantern shows a stair going down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dr. Vale comes up the steps one at a time, the lamp in the porter's hand and the page forty in his coat.

lines.speaker: haas
lines.text: Easy, doctor. Easy. You are out now.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Thirty years, Haas. And it was still exactly where we left it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At eight the pass opened and the first car came down out of the white.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I should have told you all of it years ago. The stones, the page, all of it.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: The survey will say it for us. It always did.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The page curled in the stove and was gone before anyone found the words to stop it.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Thank you. I will not forget what that cost you.

lines.speaker: haas
lines.text: Nobody is punished tonight. That is not the same as nobody being free.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No car came down in the morning. The snow had other plans for the Brandt road.

lines.speaker: haas
lines.text: It was my silence. Let the Captain pay for it, and let the rest of you go in peace.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Peace. Is that what you call it?
